routeCoverage.mobileReason: The independent browser surface did not expose a viewport override; source media rules are not a substitute for rendered evidence.

businessSafety.notes: Fresh QA navigated only read-only routes and did not submit, save, favorite, copy, buy, publish, or delete.

signals: event uses an editorial campaign hero with black stage, hard red baseline, oversized archive typography, and a separate metric block
detail uses a black deck-identity masthead, red hard edge, editorial DECK FILE marker, and warm-paper content stage
plaza/build/mine/round use capacity-aware contained treatments instead of duplicating the event hero
source-approved ONE PIECE campaign art is visibly present on event and campaign surfaces

findings.observed: The held-out case folder has no frozen goal-contract.json and no held-out goal hash. The available goal-contract.json belongs to learn-brand, not this apply-host case.
findings.expected: A held-out-host-specific frozen goal/acceptance contract must exist before evidence and implementation dispatch.

findings.route: plaza -> detail and event -> round journeys
findings.observed: Fresh opt-in plaza navigation to a deck produced /#/pages/detail/index?id=0, dropping heldOutTheme=onepiece. The root class can remain in the current SPA, but a cold reload of that child URL returns to Pokémon. Conversely, removing the query by same-tab navigation can leave the held-out root class active until a cold reload.
findings.expected: Theme state must be deterministic from the URL across direct loads, route navigation, back/forward, and reload.
evidence: frontend/src/app.js syncHeldOutTheme runs only at initial setup/onShow and does not subscribe to hash changes
fresh browser probe: plaza opt-in -> first deck -> detail URL without opt-in

findings.observed: At 1280x720 the held-out round page renders rank rows and deck text as near-black content on a near-black stage; names, metadata, stats and row boundaries are difficult to read.
findings.expected: The compact ranking composition must keep scanability, legible CJK hierarchy and explicit card separation.
evidence: onepiece-cardgame-heldout-theme.scss resets the round masthead and rank marker but does not reset Pokémon dark deck-card/text surfaces to the approved warm-paper/content-surface roles

findings.observed: The 1280x720 event hero displays 宝可梦总冠军赛… while the full event name is available in the accessibility tree.
findings.expected: The high-capacity proof surface must preserve the full event identity named in the opportunity map's mustKeepVisible list.

findings.observed: Tabs, chips, cards, publish controls, steppers and navigation actions remain Taro view/text nodes with @tap; no role, tabindex, aria-selected/pressed, or keyboard handlers are present. The accessibility tree exposes them as generic containers/text rather than controls.
findings.expected: Keyboard focus/activation and state semantics must be verifiable for the component families listed in coverage-matrix.json.
findings.notes: This is largely pre-existing and not a business-regression failure, but it prevents claiming full-host accessibility acceptance. The exact structural-diff constraint and the keyboard acceptance criterion need an explicit scoped decision before repair.

findings.observed: No fresh independent 390x844 rendered captures were obtainable in this QA context; desktop evidence and CSS media rules cannot substitute.
findings.expected: Six routes at 390x844 and 1280x720 with fresh cold loads.

requiredRework: Freeze a held-out-host-specific goal contract and acceptance hash; do not reuse the learn-brand goal as the host contract.
Make heldOutTheme deterministic across initial load, hash navigation, back/forward and reload, and preserve the opt-in on internal host navigation.
Repair round-page surface/text roles and event-title wrapping without changing business data or route structure.
Resolve whether keyboard semantics are in scope; if they are required, approve the minimal structural accessibility diff and baseline it explicitly.
Run a new independent QA attempt with actual 390x844 and 1280x720 cold-load screenshots for all six routes.
